periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, slanting downwards from the medial to lateral canthus.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped blobs with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward and lateral extension at the lower-outer quadrant, creating a distinctive teardrop-like taper.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shape curvature at the posterior boundary where the dark band meets the white dorsal fur along the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral sections covering approximately 35% of the visible vertical height of the upper torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between ear regions, approximately 1.8 to 2 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly uniform semicircular curvature with smooth, rounded superior margins.
